{{Quote|Protas, meet us in battle. Through our sheer numbers, we will overcome you.|The kikla issue their challenge, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="Tale" />}}
According to "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]," a legend told by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]], a '''battle''' was fought at the [[Ancient Trench]] between the [[Deity/Legends|god-beast]] [[Protas]], who had previously [[Battle of Thalina|defeated]] [[Melkorr]], and a legion of [[kikla]] swimmers. They fought for a [[Standard month/Legends|month]], with the kikla attempting to overwhelm Protas with their numbers. Instead, Protas took advantage of the uncoordinated strategy of the kikla, taking a single-minded approach and [[Foodstuff/Legends|eating]] them to maintain strength. At the rise of the new [[Moon/Legends|moon]], Protas [[Death/Legends|killed]] the last kikla, defending his right to rule the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. With this victory, the god-beast would grow arrogant and challenge an [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]] [[Unidentified aiwha pod|pod]], who would [[Destruction of Protas|kill]] him to avoid their own death.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Protas was strong, stronger than any living beast, and mystical. He had powers beyond comprehension.|Ryan Kaufman, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="Tale" />}}
According to "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]," a legend told by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and translated by [[Ryan Kaufman]] into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Protas]] was a strong and powerful [[Deity/Legends|monster-god]] who ruled the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of<ref name="Tale" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="Kamino">{{Film|II}}</ref> He had [[Battle of Thalina|defeated]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the dark titan [[Melkorr]] at the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] ridge at [[Thalina]] after the titan challenged him for the rule of the oceans. The [[kikla]] swimmers, a tiny yet [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species of great number, desired to rule the oceans of the planet. To this end, they assembled together as an [[Army/Legends|army]], planning to overwhelm and swarm Protas.<ref name="Tale" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Protas met the vast swarm of kikla in the deepest waters of the Ancient Trench, and there they fought.|Ryan Kaufman, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="Tale" />}}
When the kikla felt their numbers would be sufficient, they issued Protas a challenge and the battle commenced. They fought for over a [[Standard month/Legends|month]], and the kikla believed that they would be able to overwhelm and outlast the much larger god-beast. In actuality, the kikla were divided of mind and uncoordinated when they attacked with their small, sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], which could only inflict small [[Blood/Legends|wounds]]. In contrast, Protas was single-minded and scattered the kikla. He [[Foodstuff/Legends|ate]] them to maintain his stamina and continued this tactic until the last kikla was devoured at the rise of the new [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="Tale" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Now, by this time, Protas had grown old and arrogant in his power. He knew that none could oppose him, and he wielded his authority freely.|Ryan Kaufman, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="Tale" />}}
The victory, in addition to the prior victory over Melkorr, added to Protas' arrogance. In his old age, this arrogance would lead to his defeat by a [[Unidentified aiwha pod|pod]] of [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]], with whom he had prevented their passage to safer, warmer waters. The [[Pod (social group)|pod]], who attacked Protas out of necessity rather than seeking fame or glory, would rule the oceans as well as receive the respect of all the creatures of Kamino.<ref name="Tale" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of the Ancient Trench appeared in [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman's]] short story "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod (short story)|The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]," published in [[Prima Games]]'s [[2005]] [[Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide|official guide]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]].<ref name="Tale" />
